# Results on EuRoC (generated by `python tools/eval_euroc.py --render`; do not edit by hand)

Clean (undegraded) IMU input. APE = absolute position error after Umeyama alignment of the whole trajectory (SE3, or Sim3 with scale). Final = position error of the last pose after SE3. RPE 1 s = relative translation error over 200 frames. Sim3 can shrink a badly drifting trajectory toward a point (see the scale column), so it flatters drift; SE3 is the honest number.

# Official-script degraded input (from 17 Nov 2026; replaces every earlier degraded baseline)

Copies made by `python tools/official_degrade.py --all` with the organisers' `degrade_imu.py` (default levels: max_level 1.0, gamma 1.7). Reading **a** = the raw EuRoC file fed straight in (the script then puts its accelerometer faults on the gyro columns); reading **b** = columns reordered to accelerometer first. Seeds 1..3 are for tuning and comparison; seed 42 (the script's own) is reported apart. APE: SE3 Umeyama fitted on the run being scored, as the organisers score. Gap = missing-row bursts of >= 5 rows (window from the last row before to the first row after); blind = the last 5 s (exact zeros).

# Degraded input

Copies made by `python -m vortex.degrade <clean sequence> data/degraded/<sequence>_s<seed> --seed <seed>` with the default (placeholder) levels: rising white noise, bias random walk, three 2 s NaN dropouts, total failure (NaN) at 85 % of the sequence, cut 5 s later. **History, not evidence:** these copies come from our own `vortex/degrade.py`, which does not match the organisers' `degrade_imu.py` (received 17 Nov 2026). APE uses the SE3 alignment fitted once on the same main's CLEAN run (align given), so it cannot absorb a fault. Growth = how far the position error vector moves across the window (start to end).
